title: JobDescription
description: Cosmos DB 'jds' container document -- the canonical JD record (see jd_management.py). Partition key: /id. Only PUBLISHED JDs are synced to jd_folder/*.txt, which the existing resume-scoring pipeline (jd_manager.py/ResumeMEtrics.py) reads -- draft/pending/rejected/archived JDs never affect candidate matching.

id.description: Same value as jd_id -- the partition key.

jd_id.description: Stable UUID, generated at creation. Also used as the synced .txt filename stem once published, so jd_manager.py's existing jd_id convention (filename stem) is preserved.

status.description: draft -> pending_approval -> approved -> published -> archived, with pending_approval -> rejected -> draft as the rejection loop.

hiring_contact.description: Hiring manager or recruiter's display name/email -- free text, no FK to the users container (no per-JD ownership model exists yet).

source.description: How this JD's content originated. ai_generated content is still a draft until a human reviews/edits/submits it -- this field never implies auto-approval.

source_document_blob_path.description: Set when source="uploaded": path in the raw-resumes Blob container (reusing the existing blob_store.py container, no new one created for this).

ai_generation_metadata.description: Set when source="ai_generated": {model, provider, trace_id, generated_at} -- never the raw prompt (avoid logging internal prompts to a document a wider set of roles can read).

created_by.description: Username of the account that created this JD.
